PR opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/62

PROGRESS.md already reflects the completed state accurately (all checkboxes match what actually shipped). Summary of what was done:

**Root cause found and fixed**: `scripts/generate_wiring_registry.py`'s `build_routes()` only ever emitted a `hops_through` relationship for `hop.get("engine_no")` — any `hop_type: gateway` entry was silently dropped, mechanically guaranteeing the "0 gateway hops" finding this whole plan was built around. Also fixed a worktree-blind `IS_GIT_CHECKOUT` check that made the script read a stale mirror instead of local edits.

**Real trace, not assumption**: grepped `route-RT-gratuity_calculator-001`'s actual live call chain in `/opt/veridian/repos/compliance-tracker` (read-only). Found and fixed a factual error (destination was `hr-engine.ts`, which has no `calculateGratuity`; real function is in `payroll-engine.ts:29`), confirmed 2 more stages genuinely real (Intent, Context) and a real gateway boundary crossed (G04 UserChannel via `auth-guard.ts requireAuth()`, G03 Organization via `context.ts`), and confirmed 9 stages are genuinely absent from this exact path today (Planning/Policy/Decision/Automation/Integration/Data/Notification/Audit/Observability) — reported as named gaps, not fabricated.

**Acceptance bar met**: re-running the generator now shows `gateway-G04`/`gateway-G03` entity ids in this route's `hops_through` relationships, both `VERIFIED_MATCH`. Phase marked `status: done` in the plan file with full evidence, registered in the knowledge engine, PR #62 open on `claude-control`.
